chunks: Ahmad ibn Harun al-Fami (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas'ada ibn Sadaqa from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, when Allah — Blessed and Exalted — sees the people of a village committing excess in sins, and there are three believers among them, He calls to them — Exalted is His majesty, and sanctified are His names: 'O people of disobedience to Me! Were it not for the believers among you who love one another for the sake of My majesty, who enliven My earth and My mosques with their prayers, and who seek forgiveness at dawn out of fear of Me, I would have sent down My punishment upon you and not cared.'

key_terms.المتحابين بجلالي: Those who love each other for the sake of My majesty — a spiritual bond rooted in devotion to God
key_terms.المستغفرين بالأسحار: Those who seek forgiveness at dawn — the pre-dawn hours being the most spiritually potent time for repentance
key_terms.المعاصي: Sins, acts of disobedience to God

ai.seo_question: Why does Allah withhold punishment from sinful communities according to Islamic hadith?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) relates a divine address (hadith qudsi) in which Allah warns sinful communities that the presence of just three sincere believers — characterized by mutual love for God's sake, devotion to prayer, and seeking forgiveness at dawn — is what prevents divine punishment. This teaching underscores the concept of communal protection through the righteous, a theme found in Quranic narratives of destroyed nations.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Harun al-Fami (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from Harun b. Muslim from Mas`ada b. Sadaqa from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

When Allah saw the people of a village commit an excessive number of sins, it had three believers in it. He called to them: “O people of disobedience to Me! Were it not for the believers among you, who love by My majesty, establish prayer in My land and in My mosques, and repent at night out of fear of Me, I would have descended My chastisement upon you and not cared.”
